summary: Progressive Web App (PWA) requested as alternative to mobile app
architectural_notes: PWA implementation requested as alternative to native mobile app
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- PWA app icon with modern design representing a civic platform, suitable for transparent background (pwa-icon.dim_192x192.png)
- PWA app icon with modern design representing a civic platform, suitable for transparent background, larger size (pwa-icon.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Add a Web App Manifest (manifest.json) to frontend/public with appropriate metadata including name, short_name, description, theme_color, background_color, display mode set to 'standalone', start_url, and icons array with multiple sizes (192x192, 512x512)
Link the Web App Manifest in frontend/index.html using a link tag with rel='manifest' pointing to /manifest.json
Create a service worker file (sw.js) in frontend/public that implements basic caching strategies for offline functionality including cache-first for static assets and network-first for API calls
Add theme-color meta tag to frontend/index.html that matches the application's primary color scheme for consistent browser chrome styling
Generate PWA icon images in multiple sizes (at minimum 192x192 and 512x512) with a design that represents the application identity, saved to frontend/public/assets/generated

new_feature_requests.summary: Register the service worker in frontend/src/main.tsx after the React app renders, with proper error handling and browser support detection

projectName: Decline unsupported civic complaint management app request
